detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Grip it and rip it! Master your swing, build your golfer, and take on classic rounds, arcade challenges, and rivals worldwide. Every shot counts!

Pick your golfer. Build your legend.

Each character has unique strengths and weaknesses. Level up five key skills to develop your playing style:

  • Power – Hit it further.

  • Technique – Master your spin.

  • Consistency – Stay in control.

  • Accuracy – Sharpen your aim.

  • Recovery – Escape tricky situations.

Tee off across seven original courses, each with its own character, from tropical dunes to autumn greens. New landscapes, new challenges, endless ways to play.

Enjoy classic 9‑ or 18‑hole rounds, tackle Birdie or Bust for all‑or‑nothing pressure, or push your speed to the limit in Time Attack mode.

Challenge up to four players online, enter global tournaments, and climb the rankings.

  • Real, responsive golf physics.

  • Retro-inspired arcade gameplay.

  • RPG-style golfer progression.

  • Distinct characters with unique abilities.

  • Classic and arcade game modes.

  • Online multiplayer for up to 4 players.

  • Global tournaments and rankings.

 

Try the free demo and add Golf 5 MAX to your wishlist!
